APN  6232-005-805  (ADJACENT  TO  PROPERTY  ADDRESS  5911  FIRESTONE
BOULEV  ARD).

PURPOSE:  To consider  a request  to install  a new  wireless  telecommunications  facility  on an
existing  Southern  California  Edison  (SCE)  lattice  tower  located  at Assessor's  Parcel  Number
6232-005-805  (adjacent  to property  address  5911 Firestone  Boulevard).

RECOMMENDED  ACTIONS:

  a.  CONDUCT  a public  hearing;

  b.  ACCEPT  the Class 3 Categorical  Exemption  from  the California  Environmental  Quality
  Act  ("CEQA"),  codified  at Division  6 of Title  14 of the California  Code of Regulations.  A
  Class 3 Categorical  Exemption  consists  of construction  and location  of limited  numbers  of
  new,  small  facilities  or structures;  installation  of small  new  equipment  and facilities  in
  small  structures;  and the conversion  of existing  small  structures  from  one use to another
  where  only minor  modifications  are made in the exterior  of the structure.

  c,  ADOPT  the findings  under  Resolution  No. 2023-13  (see Exhibit  A), certifying  a Class 3
  Categorical  Exemption  from  the California  Environmental  Quality  Act  ("CEQA");  and
  approve  Conditional  Use Permit  No.  23-0042,  subject  to the recornrnended  conditions  of
  approval.

  d.  RECOMMEND  that the Planning  Commission  approve  the installation  of a new wireless
  telecommunications  facility  on an existing  Southern  California  Edison  lattice  tower.

PUBLIC  NOTIFICATION:  Advertising  and notification  of the public  hearing  for the application
was conducted  in compliance  with  Chapter  11.50.020,  Title  11 of the South Gate Miu'iicipal  Code.
Notice  of the hearing  was originally  posted  and published  in the "South  Gate Press"  newspaper
and was mailed  to surrounding  properties  on November  22, 2023.

ENVIRONMENTAL  EVALUATION:  This project  is Categorically  Exempt  from  CEQA  under
state regulations  known  as the "CEQA  Guidelines"  codified  at Division  6 of Title  14 of the
California  Code of Regulations.  The Class  3 Exemption  under  the CEQA  Guidelines,  at 14 CCR
Section  15303,  consists  of construction  and location  of limited  numbers  of new, small  facilities  or
structures;  installation  of small new equipment  and facilities  in small  structures;  and the conversion
of existing  small  structures  from  one use to another  where  only  minor  modifications  are made in

  8
 the exterior of the structure. The project proposal is to install a small wireless communications
facility on an existing Southern California Edison lattice tower.

ANALYSIS: Staff has completed a review of the subject application and determined that the
proposed Conditional Use Permit No. 23-0042 is in compliance with the City of South Gate’s
General Plan and South Gate Municipal Code.

Project Overview
The subject property is zoned RC (Regional Commercial) and is located on Firestone Boulevard,
between the Rio Hondo Bikeway and the City’s boundary (see Figure 1). It sits on a Corridor
Overlay Zone, El Paseo/ South Gate Towne Center (3 Sub Area) and is subject to the development
and permit procedures of the City of South Gate’s General Plan.

 Background
The project site is currently developed with an approximately 101,449 square foot self-storage
facility and 981 square foot office, which is currently occupied by Nova Storage. City records
show the following historical businesses:

  Business Name
  Current  Nova Storage
  2001  Storage Outlet
  1995  Techno-Landscape Company
  1991  Santa’s Forest
  1972  Santa’s Forest Christmas Tree Farm

The project consists of the installation of a “small wireless” (as defined by the Federal
Communications Commission) telecommunications facility on an existing Southern California
Edison lattice tower. The proposal is to install thirteen panel antennas, fourteen RRU’s (Remote
Radio Units), three surge suppressors, and one equipment cabinet with ancillary equipment.

Conditional Use Permit Findings
Conditional Use Permit No. 23-0042 is a request by Will Kazimi (“Applicant”), to allow the
installation of thirteen panel antennas, fourteen RRUs, three surge suppressors, and one equipment
cabinet with ancillary equipment. The findings are provided below:

  1. Approval of the CUP is consistent with and will not adversely affect the intent and purpose
  of this title or the city’s general plan.

  This will be a net benefit to the community and first responders since this project would
  provide improvements to voice and data coverage in the subject area and also support
  AT&T’s First Net Program for first responders. AT&T’s First Net Program is a network
  that is solely utilized by first responders, such as fire, law enforcement, Emergency
  Medical Services (EMS), etc. By having first responders utilize a separate network, without
  commercial traffic, AT&T would be able to provide first responders with fast and reliable
  communication during emergency situations.

  2. The design and development of the land use and conditions of the CUP are compatible
  with the existing and future land uses of the applicable zone.

  The proposed wireless telecommunication facility is located approximately 879 feet from
  the public right-of-way on a parcel owned by SCE improved with existing SCE
  transmission towers, within the City’s Regional Commercial zone. The remainder of the
  parcel on which the telecommunication facility is located is currently being used as a
  storage facility.

  3. Approval of the CUP would not result in detrimental impacts to adjacent properties or to
  the character or function of the neighborhood.

  Approval of the CUP would not result in detrimental impacts to adjacent properties or to

  10
   the character or function of the neighborhood since the proposed project does not constitute
  a change or intensification of use. The proposed facility is compatible with the nearby
  wireless facility that is located on the subject parcel regarding similar equipment and
  overall design. Given that the parcel is in the City of South Gate’s Regional Commercial
  zone with four existing SCE transmission towers, one of which will be utilized for the
  proposed telecommunication facility.

  4. The project proposal is exempt from CEQA under Class 3 Categorical Exemption.

  The proposed Conditional Use Permit is Categorically Exempt from the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Class 3 Categorical Exemption pursuant to
  Section 15303 of the CEQA Guidelines. The proposed project consists of one new small
  wireless communication facility to be constructed on an existing SCE lattice tower. Class
  3 consists of construction and location of limited numbers of new, small facilities or
  structures; installation of small new equipment and facilities in small structures; and the
  conversion of existing small structures from one use to another where only minor
  modifications are made in the exterior of the structure. As such, this project is consistent
  with a Class 3 Categorical Exemption.

Planning Conditions:

  1. Permittee shall ensure that the proposed project meets all FCC emissions guidelines.

  2. The plans contain a licensed engineer’s stamp.

  3. All elements of the project should be included within the materials submitted.

  4. Permittee shall ensure that the equipment enclosure associated with this wireless site is
  always properly locked except when there is active maintenance.

  5. Permittee shall ensure that all required radio frequency signage be installed and maintained
  at all times in good condition adjacent to the base of the SCE tower near the climbing leg
  space.

  6. Permittee shall ensure that all federally required radio frequency signage be installed and
  maintained at all times in good condition. All such radio frequency signage be constructed
  of hard materials and be UV stabilized. All radio frequency signage must comply with the
  sign colors, sign sizes, sign symbols, and sign panel layouts in conformance with the most
  current versions of ANSI Z535.1, ANSI Z535.2, and ANSI C95.2 standards. All such radio
  frequency signage, or additional signage immediately adjacent to the radio frequency
  signage, shall provide a working local or toll-free telephone number to its network
  operations center that reaches a live person who can exert transmitter power-down control
  over this site as required by the FCC.

  7. In the event that the FCC changes any of radio frequency signage requirements that are
  applicable to the project site approved herein or ANSI Z535.1, ANSI Z535.2, and ANSI
  C95.2 standards that are applicable to the project site approved herein are changed,
  Permittee, within 30 days of each such change, at its own cost and expense, shall replace
  the signage at the project site to comply with the then current standards.

  8. All wireless telecommunications facilities shall be designed to minimize the visual impact
  to the surrounding area to the maximum extent feasible.

  9. An exterior cable chase may be permitted in areas where the visual impact would not be
  significant to the surrounding properties.

  10. All antennas do not have any exposed cables, where feasible.

  11. Where feasible, all ground-mounted equipment be contained within cabinets.

  12. Enclosure access gate shall be opaque, compatible with the enclosure material, and where
  feasible be facing away from street or primary public view.

SUBJECT:  PROPOSED  MURAL  FOR  EXISTING  BUSINESS,  LOCATED  AT  4000
TWEEDY  BOULEVARD  ("GRIFFITH  INSURANCE  & FINANCIAL  SERVICES  INC.")

PURPOSE:  To receive  and file  the proposed  painted  outdoor  mural  for  an existing  business,
located  at 4000 Tweedy  Boulevard  (Griffith  Insurance  & Financial  Services  Inc.)

RECOMMENDED  ACTION:

  1.  RECEIVE  AND  FILE  the proposed  painted  mural  for  Griffith  Insurance  & Financial
  Services  Inc. located  at 4000 Tweedy  Boulevard.

BACKGROUND:  Griffith  Insurance  & Financial  Services,  Inc is an independently  owned  family
business  that provides  insurance  coverage  for liomes,  businesses,  and automobiles.  The business
has been operating  in South Gate since 1998.

The business  is located  along Tweedy  Boulevard  at the southeast  corner  of San Luis Avenue  and
Tweedy  Boulevard.  The  subject  space is across  San Luis  Avenue  from  Ziegler's  Hardware  &
Supply  store and across Tweedy  Boulevard  from  Leland  R. Weaver  Los Angeles  County  Library.

ANALYSIS:  On October  9, 2023,  the applicant  Tanya  Martinez  (Representative),  on behalf  of
Griffith  Insurance  & Financial  Services  Inc (Business  owner),  submitted  a request  to paint  a mural
on the western  exterior  wall  of the business,  which  would  be visible  to pedestrian  and vehicular
traffic  traveling  north  and south on San Luis  Avenue  and traveling  east on Tweedy  Boulevard.

Pursuant  to South  Gate Municipal  Code Chapter  11.36 "Signs,"  murals  which  do "...not  pertain
to the business,  product  or service  rendered  on the premises  shall be considered  a mural..."  and
"size,  height,  locations,  and other restrictions..."  require  the review  of the Planning  Coinrnission.

The proposed  mural  would  measure  approximately  sixty-three  feet in width  and seventeen  feet in
height  along San Luis Avenue.  The muralist  would  be Michelle  Guerrero,  a San Diego  native,  who
uses elements  of her heritage  as inspiration  for her striking  and lively  work.  The muralist  has done
recent work  for the Los Angeles  Dodgers  and the Los Angeles  Rams.  One recent  example  was for
Payne Elementaty  School  in the City  of Inglewood  depicting  the Los Angeles  Rams in a bus with
animated  characters  in honor  of Latino  Heritage  Month.

The muralist  believes  the location  of the mural  would  serve the community  of South  Gate, given
it is near San Miguel  Elementary  School  and across from  Leland  R. Weaver  Los Angeles  County

  32
 Library.

The theme of the proposed mural is “bringing the community together,” where she depicts
characters playing music along the backdrop of a fair and city buildings. The artist believes the
artwork is a means of bringing the residents of South Gate together, similar to the annual Tweedy
Boulevard Mile Street Fair.

Planning Conditions

1.  Except as set forth in conditions, development shall take place substantially as shown on
  the approved elevation rendering. Any material deviations must be approved by the
  Planning Commission.

2.  Within thirty (30) days of review of the project, the Business and property owners shall
  certify his/her acceptance of the conditions placed on the approval by signing a notarized
  Affidavit of Acceptance stating that he/she accepts and shall be bound by all of the
  conditions.

3.  Review shall be valid for twelve (12) months from the date of the final determination.

4.  The applicant shall defend and hold harmless and indemnify the City and its agents,
  officers and employees from any claim, action, or proceeding against the City or its agents,
  officers or employees to attack, set aside, void or annul any approval by the City
  concerning the project. The City shall promptly notify the applicant of any filed claim,
  action or proceeding and shall cooperate fully in the defense of the actions.

5.  Applicant shall agree to the removal of graffiti incidents within 24 hours.

6.  Applicant shall maintain and preserve the mural in good condition to the satisfaction of the
  City.

7.  The premises shall be maintained at all times in a neat and orderly manner. This includes
  private and public right of way immediately adjacent to the business and maintain a routine
  property maintenance plan.

8.  A sign permit shall become null and void if the sign(s) for which the permit was issued has
  not been installed within one year of permit issuance.

9.  Any sign permit granted may be revoked, according to municipal code Section 11.51.090.

10.  The applicant shall submit the endorsement of either the owner of the premises or an
  authorized representative of the owner for proposed mural work.

11.  The design of the mural shall be consistent with professional graphic standards.
